verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Alloy can generate alerts or investigations when thresholds are met, and it mentions that manual reviews occur. Nothing documents assigning cases to analysts or routing them through defined review and escalation stages. Creating investigations is an adjacent capability and does not count as the case-assignment and staged-routing workflow the story asks for.

support.subject: As a operations-lead, I can assign cases and route them through analyst review and escalation stages
